deals.travelWindow: Sep 30 – Dec 6, cheapest early Dec and Sep 30/Oct 3
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant's own fare search still shows $62 (Dec 6) and $68 (Sep 30, Oct 3) one-way today — a twelfth straight day as the cheapest verified fare of the five, with the Smokies' Greenbrier entrance 45 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore alone on foot, and the park's Greenbrier and Cosby entrances are quieter than the Cades Cove side.

highlights: Market Square farmers market and street performers
Sunsphere observation deck over World's Fair Park
Ijams Nature Center quarry swimming hole
Knoxville Museum of Art
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Sunsphere and World's Fair Park on arrival, Market Square for dinner and street music.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Greenbrier: the Ramsey Cascades or Porters Creek trailhead, back by early evening.
Day 3 — Knoxville Museum of Art, Ijams Nature Center quarry swim before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Ijams are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is required to reach the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable, close to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.travelWindow: Late Oct – early Dec, cheapest midweek, book 14+ days out
deals.whyRanked: United's fare dropped to $165 round trip basic economy (posted today on The Flight Deal, $265 for regular economy) — down from $206-230 earlier this week — jumping Denver past Fort Lauderdale on price alone, with Rocky Mountain National Park under 2 hours away.
deals.soloWhy: The 16th Street Mall and RTD light rail make downtown and the Highlands easy to cover on foot or transit, and Union Station is a lively, safe evening hub.

highlights: Union Station's Great Hall and food stalls
Larimer Square and RiNo Art District murals
Denver Art Museum
Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Denver Art Museum on arrival, Union Station's Great Hall for dinner and people-watching.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: Bear Lake Road trailheads (Dream Lake or Emerald Lake), back by evening.
Day 3 — Larimer Square and RiNo Art District murals, Red Rocks Park at sunset before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The A Line train connects the airport to Union Station; RTD light rail and buses cover downtown, but a rental car is needed for Rocky Mountain NP or Red Rocks.
guide.stayArea: LoDo (Lower Downtown) near Union Station — walkable to Larimer Square, the light rail, and RiNo.
food: Casa Bonita (only if you want the spectacle)

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's own site still shows one-way fares as low as $80 for October and November, unchanged from yesterday, holding at #3 as Denver's price drop pushed it down a spot — Everglades day trips are an hour inland.
deals.soloWhy: Las Olas Boulevard and the beachfront promenade stay busy and walkable well into the evening, with the free Sun Trolley covering downtown.

highlights: Las Olas Boulevard shops and cafes
Fort Lauderdale beachfront promenade
Riverwalk and the NSU Art Museum
Everglades Shark Valley bike loop
Bonnet House Museum & Gardens
itinerary: Day 1 — Beachfront promenade on arrival, Las Olas Boulevard for dinner.
Day 2 — Everglades NP Shark Valley: rent a bike for the 15-mile paved loop, alligators guaranteed.
Day 3 — Riverwalk and NSU Art Museum, Bonnet House gardens before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Sun Trolley covers downtown and the beach; a rental car is worth it for the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: Las Olas or the beachfront — walkable, close to restaurants and the water taxi stops.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's own site shows one-way fares cooling to $87 today, down from yesterday's $110 spike but still above last week's $59 flash sale — DC holds #4 on the highest solo score of the five and Shenandoah National Park 75 minutes out.
deals.soloWhy: The Metro reaches nearly every monument and museum, the Mall is safe to walk solo well into the evening, and the Smithsonians are free.

highlights: National Mall monuments at sunrise before the crowds
Smithsonian museums (all free)
National Archives to see the original Constitution
Great Falls Park overlook on the Potomac
Shenandoah's Skyline Drive
itinerary: Day 1 — Mall monuments on arrival, Eastern Market for dinner.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Shenandoah: Skyline Drive to the Stony Man or Hawksbill summit trailhead.
Day 3 — National Archives and a Smithsonian museum, Great Falls Park at sunset before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Metro covers the Mall, museums, and most neighborhoods; a rental car is only needed for Shenandoah or Great Falls.
guide.stayArea: Near a Metro stop on the Orange/Blue/Silver line (Capitol Hill or Foggy Bottom) for the fastest reach to the Mall.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's own site confirms one-way fares from $95 today for late October and November, essentially flat with recent days, rounding out the top 5 alongside Fort Lauderdale for the cheap-Florida run.
deals.soloWhy: The free TECO Line streetcar links downtown, the Riverwalk, and Ybor City, so evenings out don't require a car or rideshare.

highlights: Tampa Riverwalk (2.5 miles, connects downtown's museums)
Ybor City's cigar factories, bars, and Cuban sandwiches
Florida Aquarium
Tampa History Center
Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park
itinerary: Day 1 — Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park on arrival, Riverwalk stroll at sunset.
Day 2 — Free streetcar to Ybor City: cigar factory tours, 7th Avenue murals, Columbia Restaurant for dinner.
Day 3 — Florida Aquarium and Tampa History Center, Armature Works food hall before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free TECO Line streetcar connects downtown, the Channel District, and Ybor City; a rideshare covers the beaches, which are 30-45 minutes out.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the Channel District — walkable to the Riverwalk and a streetcar ride from Ybor City.
